effects.window: Main Phase of your turn, when you could activate a Spell Card; you can only activate 1 "Freezing Chains of the Ice Barrier" per turn
effects.effect: When this card is activated: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower "Ice Barrier" monster in your GY; Special Summon it.
effects.targets: 1 Level 4 or lower "Ice Barrier" monster in your GY (optional)
